messages:
noah: Heads-up — MeridianMed flagged a Dedicated overage on their April invoice. They insist no heavy jobs ran during the window. Can someone pull the attribution?

priya: I will grab the slot and token-level breakdown. Do we have the invoice line ref?

noah: Invoice 2026-04-18, line: DEDICATED_OVERRUN $1,760. Attached their CSV.

billing-bot: System note: Invoice 2026-04-18 for account meridian-med (acct_4411). Line items:
```
DEDICATED_COMMIT_MONTHLY  1  $9,500.00
DEDICATED_OVERRUN         1  $1,760.00  (2026-04-14 03:10 - 2026-04-14 03:45)
TAX                       1  $560.00
```

priya: Pulling logs...

priya: Found high token emission on pool dm-4 during that window. Sample lines: 
```
2026-04-14T03:12:05Z host-dm04 req=c9f1 model=rw-13b tokens=12200 tenant=acct_4411
2026-04-14T03:12:06Z host-dm04 req=c9f2 model=rw-13b tokens=16000 tenant=acct_9900
```
This looks mixed; acct_9900 emitted majority of tokens.

noah: Who is acct_9900?

priya: acct_9900 = integrio-sandbox (internal partner). They have a fallback policy that allows spill into Dedicated pools when regional capacity is constrained.

tony: Anything in infra alerts?

infra-bot: Alert routing-collision-2026-04-14 created and assigned to infra-team.

noah: If the overrun was caused by integrio-sandbox, we should reverse MeridianMeds charge and bill integrio. Also consider a small goodwill credit for MeridianMed.

priya: I calculated token split: ~78% integrio, ~22% MeridianMed. Overrun $1,760 -> integrio share $1,372.80. Recommend: credit MeridianMed full $1,760, issue chargeback CB-2026-04-9900 for $1,372.80, and apply a $50 goodwill credit to MeridianMed.

tony: Approve. Also we need a quick config change: Dedicated pools should deny fallback except with explicit routing tag. I'll open a PR.

noah: Approved. Priya please create credit memo and chargeback invoice, and notify both customers.

priya: Done. CM-2026-04-MER-01 issued for $1,760.00, GC-2026-04-MER-01 $50 goodwill, CB-2026-04-9900 for $1,372.80. billing-bot updated invoice 2026-04-18-v2 (overrun removed).

billing-bot: Action complete: credit memo created and new invoice issued.

noah: MeridianMed confirmed receipt and is satisfied. Assigning postmortem to Tony to complete within one week.

tony: Will do. PR to restrict fallback routing opened: #4783.

priya: I'll also add an automated validation to match tenant IDs on token attribution before billing overrun lines.

noah: Thanks all, closing the loop.
